# M365 Trace Analyzer usage telemetry

Privacy-first reporting for the allowlisted `ApplicationStarted` and `TraceImportCompleted` events. All panels use a rolling 30-day window and telemetry schema version 1. Values can be spoofed because the desktop connection string is a routing identifier, not an authentication secret.

content.query:
let UsageEvents = AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| where Name in ("ApplicationStarted", "TraceImportCompleted")
| extend InstallationId = tostring(Properties["installation_id"]), ApplicationSessionId = tostring(Properties["application_session_id"]), Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]);
UsageEvents
| summarize Installations = dcountif(InstallationId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), ApplicationSessions = dcountif(ApplicationSessionId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), TraceImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted"), CompleteImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted" and Outcome == "complete"), PartialImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted" and Outcome == "partial"), FailedImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted" and Outcome == "failed"), CancelledImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted" and Outcome == "cancelled")
content.title: 30-day overview

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| where Name in ("ApplicationStarted", "TraceImportCompleted")
| extend InstallationId = tostring(Properties["installation_id"]), ApplicationSessionId = tostring(Properties["application_session_id"])
| summarize Installations = dcountif(InstallationId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), ApplicationSessions = dcountif(ApplicationSessionId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), TraceImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Daily adoption and imports

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| where Name in ("ApplicationStarted", "TraceImportCompleted")
| extend InstallationId = tostring(Properties["installation_id"]), ApplicationSessionId = tostring(Properties["application_session_id"]), AppVersion = tostring(Properties["app_version"])
| summarize Installations = dcountif(InstallationId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), ApplicationSessions = dcountif(ApplicationSessionId, Name == "ApplicationStarted"), TraceImports = countif(Name == "TraceImportCompleted") by AppVersion
| order by AppVersion desc
content.title: Version adoption

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Name == "ApplicationStarted"
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| extend InstallationId = tostring(Properties["installation_id"]), ApplicationSessionId = tostring(Properties["application_session_id"])
| summarize Installations = dcount(InstallationId), ApplicationSessions = dcount(ApplicationSessionId) by ClientCountryOrRegion
| order by Installations desc
content.title: Country or region

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Name == "TraceImportCompleted"
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| extend Format = tostring(Properties["format"]), Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
| summarize Imports = count() by Outcome, Format
| order by Imports desc
content.title: Import outcomes by format

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Name == "TraceImportCompleted"
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| extend AppVersion = tostring(Properties["app_version"]), Format = tostring(Properties["format"]), Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]), ErrorCode = tostring(Properties["error_code"])
| where Outcome in ("partial", "failed", "cancelled") or ErrorCode != "none"
| summarize Attempts = count() by Outcome, ErrorCode, Format, AppVersion
| order by Attempts desc
content.title: Normalized failures, partial imports, and cancellations

content.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Name == "TraceImportCompleted"
| where tostring(Properties["CategoryName"]) == "M365TraceAnalyzer.UsageTelemetry"
| where tostring(Properties["telemetry_schema_version"]) == "1"
| extend Format = tostring(Properties["format"]), Encrypted = tostring(Properties["encrypted"]), SessionCountBucket = tostring(Properties["session_count_bucket"]), DurationBucket = tostring(Properties["duration_bucket"])
| summarize Imports = count() by Format, Encrypted, SessionCountBucket, DurationBucket
| order by Imports desc
content.title: Import profile
